decisions.reason: Because these modular waste-to-energy extensions are closely tied to the firm's core engineering offer and can be carried with relatively limited additional commitment, management would likely keep them despite weak recent visibility.

After several years without visible market presence, this flagship waste-oil-to-energy plant would likely be judged as falling short of aspirations, so management would redeploy resources to stronger core activities and new development.

Given its continued absence from the website, higher commercial and technical uncertainty, and the firm's many alternative innovation opportunities, management would likely discontinue this plastic-waste-to-fuel plant and shift resources elsewhere.
